Objective: List all approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) indicated for breast cancer, returning ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication EFO ID, indication label, and max phase.  
Output: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind  
Source: molecule_dictionary (core molecule data), drug_indication (indication details), compound_structures (canonical SMILES)  
Logic: Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, join drug_indication to compound_structures on molregno, filter drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND drug_indication.indication_label = 'breast cancer', select distinct rows, sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
